fact: Afrique-sur7 reports that the DRC relaunched its land cadastre digitisation project, e-Foncier, with Dubai firm Oxinus after the 2022 eProseed contract failed, and that a meeting led to e-Foncier being integrated into the country's land management.

Fonaredd reports a workshop on 26 February 2026 presented an evaluation of pilot initiatives for the land information system and proposed an e-SIF 2.0 architecture of digitised archives, a GIS digital cadastre and digitised transactions, with deployment still to come.

BETO reports the land minister told the 28 August 2026 Council of Ministers that physical archives were being sorted (16,622 files in 17 Kinshasa districts) before any cadastre digitisation, with 146 offices still to equip to make the national land title register operational.
